proposal.title: The proposal's headline, shown to the client. Leave blank to use the quote number.
proposal.issueDate: The date the quote is issued. Used in the quote number and validity window.
proposal.expiryDate: The last day this quote is valid. Must be on or after the issue date.
proposal.discountPct: A document-wide discount applied to the subtotal before VAT.
proposal.taxRate: VAT rate applied to the taxable base (subtotal minus discount).
proposal.supervisionPct: Supervision fee charged after VAT, as a percentage of the taxable base. The client pays it.
proposal.currency: The currency shown on this quote. Defaults to EGP.
proposal.sectionTitle: Name of this section. Pick a saved title or type a new one to add it to your library.
proposal.lineUnitPrice: Price charged to the client per unit, before any line discount.
proposal.lineUnitCost: Your internal cost per unit. Never shown to the client.
proposal.lineDiscountPct: A discount applied to this line only.

auth.email: We email you a one-time code to sign in. No password needed.

onboarding.orgName: Your company name, shown on quotes and to your team.

org.name: Your organisation's name, shown across the app and on client documents.
org.hideMarginFromPm: When on, project managers cannot see cost or margin figures.

account.displayName: The name teammates see next to your activity.

client.name: The client's name, in Arabic or English. At least one is required.
client.contactName: The person you usually deal with at this client.
client.email: Primary email for sending this client proposals.
client.phone: A contact phone number for this client.
client.address: The client's full address, shown on documents.
client.taxRegistrationNumber: The client's tax registration number, printed on invoices.
client.type: Whether this client is an individual, a company, or a consultant.
client.advancePct: Default advance payment percentage for this client's contracts.
client.retentionPct: Default retention percentage withheld on this client's contracts.
client.notes: Private notes about this client. Never shown to the client.

project.code: A short unique code for this project within your organisation.
project.name: The project's name, in Arabic or English. At least one is required.
project.client: The client this project belongs to.
project.type: The kind of project (villa, office, …). Pick one or add a new type.
project.description: A short description of the scope of work.
project.advancePct: Advance payment percentage agreed for this project.
project.retentionPct: Retention percentage withheld on this project's payments.

costItem.code: A short unique code for this item within your price book.
costItem.name: The item's name, in Arabic or English. At least one is required.
costItem.category: The trade or discipline this item belongs to.
costItem.unit: The unit this item is measured in.
costItem.defaultUnitCost: Your default internal cost per unit. Never shown to clients.
costItem.defaultUnitPrice: The default price charged to clients per unit.

priceBook.category: Limit the update to one category, or apply it to all.
priceBook.pctChange: The percentage to raise or lower by. Use a negative value to reduce.
priceBook.target: Whether the change applies to cost, price, or both.
priceBook.importFile: A CSV file of cost items. Existing codes are skipped, new ones added.

team.email: The email address to send the invitation to.
team.role: The permissions this teammate will have.
